description: Demolition of existing buildings at 291 Harrow Road and 1-2 Elmfield Way and the Multi Use Games Area (MUGA)/ All Weather Play Space and replacement with three buildings at 15, 10 and 5  storeys in height to create residential dwellings (Use Class C3) and an Adult Social Care homes) (Use Class C3), a commercial unit at ground floor fronting Harrow Road (Class E) and a play court (Class F.2c) on the corner of Harrow Road and Elmfield Way,  with associated amenity space, communal facilities, play space, cycle parking, waste stores, roof gardens, plant, landscaping and highways and public realm improvements.
